scenes.narration: Welcome to Aivorah's teacher courses. In the next two minutes, you'll meet the four AI tools that can save you hours every week, and learn which one to reach for.
You don't need to learn every AI tool out there. You just need the right one for the job. Almost everything a teacher needs is covered by four.
First, ChatGPT, your all-rounder. It's brilliant for lesson ideas, worksheets, quizzes, and rewriting anything in seconds. If you only try one, start here.
Next, Claude. It shines with long documents and thoughtful writing. Paste an entire chapter and get a summary, or turn rough notes into warm, careful feedback.
Then there's Gemini. If your school uses Google, it works right inside Docs, Slides, Gmail and Classroom, drafting a deck or a parent email without ever leaving the app you already use.
And Perplexity. Unlike the others, it shows you the sources behind every answer. Perfect when accuracy matters, like facts, dates, and science.
Here's your one task: pick a single tool and use it this week. Mastering one beats dabbling in four. That's it, you've met your AI assistants.
